task: Known-pocket seeded local pose recovery, three public crystal complexes

protocol.symmetry_rmsd: RDKit CalcRMS without ligand alignment, conjugated terminal symmetry enabled
protocol.threshold_pass: RMSD<=2A AND finite, bond drift<=.002A, minimum receptor heavy distance>=1A
protocol.timing: One CPU single-thread wall-clock sample per optimizer; not a speed comparison

input_preparation.10gs: Bundled inputs as supplied including existing H/heteroatoms
input_preparation.public_pockets: Official pinned Vina receptorH PDB; complete ATOM residues if any atom<=12A from any crystal SDF atom including H; retain H, omit HETATM/TER, append END; ligand copied verbatim, heavy ligand optimization/RMSD.

5x72_explicit_altloc_A.policy: Select explicit conformation A: drop B ATOM records and blank A altloc labels before RDKit; no implicit selection.

baseline.label: b229264-immutable-baseline
limitations: One crystal complex; not a population success-rate estimate.
Crystal-derived starts; not conformer generation, global docking or cross-docking.
Inferred chemistry; no authoritative prepared-receptor parity claim.
One timing sample per optimizer; no throughput/speedup claim.
Sanity checks cover finite coordinates, bond drift and <1A heavy clashes only.

metric.name: RDKit CalcRMS, fixed receptor frame
metric.reporting_reference: same crystal intramolecular energy across starts/optimizers
